value.content:
Pip is too scared to try hopping the stream stones in front of his friends. #SleepyMeadowStories Oona the owl teaches him that wobbling isn't failing — it's part of learning, and you only have to try the first small step.

This video uses AI narration and AI-generated illustrations.

#BedtimeStory #BraveBunny #PipTheBunny #GrowthMindset
